_comment: Editorial content for HMB. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: a generic bank-branch photograph would imply it is one of HABIBMETRO's own branches.
description: Habib Metropolitan Bank Limited (HABIBMETRO) was incorporated in Pakistan as a public listed company in 1992 and describes itself as a leading trade finance bank, operating more than 550 branches in over 200 cities — including dedicated Islamic branches and Islamic windows — and an offshore banking unit in the Karachi Export Processing Zone. It serves retail, corporate, commercial and Islamic banking customers through mobile and internet banking and a network of more than 600 ATMs. The bank is a subsidiary of Habib Bank AG Zurich.
headOffice: Registered / Head Office Building, I.I. Chundrigar Road, Karachi, Pakistan
